scientific_question: Does replacing native Muon's rank-sensitive polar map with the same ridge-smoothed polar map for both dense and compact MLPs preserve dense-model quality while closing the compact full-MLP loss gap?

same_momentum_polar_amplification.finding: Pair-VQ and dense requested gradients are nearly identical before Muon, but native NS5 amplifies their small difference by at least 3.982x late in training.

spectral_damping_oracle.reason_for_prior_rejection: The candidate changed native Muon's dense direction (minimum cosine 0.90013). That is not a valid rejection criterion when dense and compact controls both use the same alternative optimizer geometry.

compact_endpoint.finding: Changing retraction cadence improved systems performance but did not close the quality gap, so the next intervention must target the optimizer vector field rather than another codec coefficient.

causal_basis.representation_closure: Fixed affine history, moving linear atlases, structured low-state charts, depth-shared trunks, and Pair-VQ value refinements all failed to represent the rotating self-path update field closely enough.

theory.rank_sensitivity: The polar map U(X)=X(X^T X)^{-1/2} is non-Lipschitz at rank loss; small compact perturbations in weak singular modes can rotate U(X) by much more than they rotate X.
theory.matched_optimizer_principle: The compact model should not be judged against native Muon after changing only its optimizer. Both the dense control and compact candidate must follow one identical smoothed vector field.
theory.fast_operator: After transposing X so m<=n and normalizing its Frobenius norm, set tau=rho/sqrt(m), form X_aug=[X,tau*I_m], apply the deployed five Newton-Schulz steps to X_aug, retain the original n columns, and restore Frobenius norm sqrt(m) before the existing rectangular Muon scale. The ridge makes every augmented singular value at least tau and bounds angular sensitivity near weak modes.
theory.persistent_state: The identity block is ephemeral. The operator adds no learned parameter, dense master weight, or persistent optimizer tensor.
theory.optimizer_flops: For the 4:1 GPT MLP matrices, augmenting width 4m to 5m increases the width-dependent portion of each polar step by 25% and the complete polar kernel by approximately 22.2%; exact end-to-end throughput is measured rather than inferred.

scope: dense MLP c_fc and c_proj matrices
Pair-VQ MLP c_fc and c_proj requested gradients

stage_3_dense_quality_gate.model: 124M QK-only mapped attention plus dense MLP

stage_4_compact_gap_gate.authorization: run only after every dense gate passes
stage_4_compact_gap_gate.model: same 124M QK-only parent with full Pair-VQ MLP replacement

decision_rule.operator_or_system_fail: Reject this fast smoothed-polar implementation without a rho sweep.
decision_rule.dense_fail: Reject matched ridge-polar optimization; do not run the compact endpoint.
decision_rule.compact_fail: Reject optimizer smoothing as sufficient to close the compact full-MLP gap; return to compact-native nonlinear parameterization.
decision_rule.compact_pass: Replicate at 5TPP seed 1 before composing compact attention V/output; no model-size scale-up is authorized by this screen.

monitoring.performance_gates: foreground poll only when expected below five minutes
monitoring.training: persistent terminal/error-only watchdog; no progress callback for runs expected within one to two hours
